## Idea

The {{#concept "ideal generated by a subset" Disambiguation="commutative semirings" Agda=ideal-subset-Commutative-Semiring}} `S` of
a [commutative semiring](commutative-algebra.commutative-semirings.md) `R` is the least [ideal](commutative-algebra.ideals-commutative-semirings.md) in `R` containing
the [subset](commutative-algebra.subsets-commutative-semirings.md) `S`. More explicitly, it is the ideal that consists of the [linear combinations](commutative-algebra.linear-combinations-of-elements-commutative-semirings.md) of elements in `S`.

## Definitions

### The universal property of ideals generated by a subset of a commutative semiring

```agda
module _
  {l1 l2 l3 : Level} (R : Commutative-Semiring l1) (S : subset-Commutative-Semiring l2 R)
  (I : ideal-Commutative-Semiring l3 R)
  where

  is-ideal-generated-by-subset-Commutative-Semiring : UUω
  is-ideal-generated-by-subset-Commutative-Semiring =
    is-ideal-generated-by-subset-Semiring
      ( semiring-Commutative-Semiring R)
      ( S)
      ( I)

  contains-subset-is-ideal-generated-by-subset-Commutative-Semiring :
    is-ideal-generated-by-subset-Commutative-Semiring →
    S ⊆ subset-ideal-Commutative-Semiring R I
  contains-subset-is-ideal-generated-by-subset-Commutative-Semiring =
    contains-subset-is-ideal-generated-by-subset-Semiring
      ( semiring-Commutative-Semiring R)
      ( S)
      ( I)

  leq-is-ideal-generated-by-subset-Commutative-Semiring :
    is-ideal-generated-by-subset-Commutative-Semiring →
    {l4 : Level} (J : ideal-Commutative-Semiring l4 R) →
    S ⊆ subset-ideal-Commutative-Semiring R J →
    leq-ideal-Commutative-Semiring R I J
  leq-is-ideal-generated-by-subset-Commutative-Semiring =
    leq-is-ideal-generated-by-subset-Semiring
      ( semiring-Commutative-Semiring R)
      ( S)
      ( I)
```

### The universal property of ideals generated by a family of subsets of a commutative semiring

```agda
module _
  {l1 l2 l3 l4 : Level} (R : Commutative-Semiring l1) {U : UU l2}
  (S : U → subset-Commutative-Semiring l3 R)
  (I : ideal-Commutative-Semiring l4 R)
  (H : (α : U) → S α ⊆ subset-ideal-Commutative-Semiring R I)
  where

  is-ideal-generated-by-family-of-subsets-Commutative-Semiring : UUω
  is-ideal-generated-by-family-of-subsets-Commutative-Semiring =
    is-ideal-generated-by-family-of-subsets-Semiring
      ( semiring-Commutative-Semiring R)
      ( S)
      ( I)
      ( H)
```

### Construction of the Galois connection of ideals generated by subsets

#### Ideals generated by subsets

  is-closed-under-two-sided-multiplication-ideal-subset-Commutative-Semiring =

  is-closed-under-left-multiplication-ideal-subset-Commutative-Semiring :

  is-closed-under-left-multiplication-ideal-subset-Commutative-Semiring =

#### The subset relation is preserved by generating ideals

```agda
module _
  {l1 : Level} (A : Commutative-Semiring l1)
  where

  preserves-order-ideal-subset-Commutative-Semiring :
    {l2 l3 : Level}
    (S : subset-Commutative-Semiring l2 A)
    (T : subset-Commutative-Semiring l3 A) →
    S ⊆ T →
    leq-ideal-Commutative-Semiring A
      ( ideal-subset-Commutative-Semiring A S)
      ( ideal-subset-Commutative-Semiring A T)
  preserves-order-ideal-subset-Commutative-Semiring =
    preserves-order-ideal-subset-Semiring
      ( semiring-Commutative-Semiring A)

  ideal-subset-hom-large-poset-Commutative-Semiring :
    hom-Large-Poset
      ( λ l2 → l1 ⊔ l2)
      ( powerset-Large-Poset (type-Commutative-Semiring A))
      ( ideal-Commutative-Semiring-Large-Poset A)
  ideal-subset-hom-large-poset-Commutative-Semiring =
    ideal-subset-hom-large-poset-Semiring
      ( semiring-Commutative-Semiring A)
```

#### The Galois connection `S ↦ (S)`

```agda
module _
  {l1 : Level} (A : Commutative-Semiring l1)
  where

  adjoint-relation-ideal-subset-Commutative-Semiring :
    {l2 l3 : Level}
    (S : subset-Commutative-Semiring l2 A)
    (I : ideal-Commutative-Semiring l3 A) →
    leq-ideal-Commutative-Semiring A (ideal-subset-Commutative-Semiring A S) I ↔
    (S ⊆ subset-ideal-Commutative-Semiring A I)
  adjoint-relation-ideal-subset-Commutative-Semiring =
    adjoint-relation-ideal-subset-Semiring
      ( semiring-Commutative-Semiring A)

  ideal-subset-galois-connection-Commutative-Semiring :
    galois-connection-Large-Poset
      ( l1 ⊔_) (λ l → l)
      ( powerset-Large-Poset (type-Commutative-Semiring A))
      ( ideal-Commutative-Semiring-Large-Poset A)
  ideal-subset-galois-connection-Commutative-Semiring =
    ideal-subset-galois-connection-Semiring
      ( semiring-Commutative-Semiring A)
```

### The ideal generated by a family of subsets of a commutative semiring

```agda
module _
  {l1 l2 l3 : Level} (R : Commutative-Semiring l1)
  {U : UU l2} (S : U → subset-Commutative-Semiring l3 R)
  where

  generating-subset-ideal-family-of-subsets-Commutative-Semiring :
    subset-Commutative-Semiring (l2 ⊔ l3) R
  generating-subset-ideal-family-of-subsets-Commutative-Semiring =
    generating-subset-ideal-family-of-subsets-Semiring
      ( semiring-Commutative-Semiring R)
      ( S)

  ideal-family-of-subsets-Commutative-Semiring :
    ideal-Commutative-Semiring (l1 ⊔ l2 ⊔ l3) R
  ideal-family-of-subsets-Commutative-Semiring =
    ideal-family-of-subsets-Semiring
      ( semiring-Commutative-Semiring R)
      ( S)

  subset-ideal-family-of-subsets-Commutative-Semiring :
    subset-Commutative-Semiring (l1 ⊔ l2 ⊔ l3) R
  subset-ideal-family-of-subsets-Commutative-Semiring =
    subset-ideal-family-of-subsets-Semiring
      ( semiring-Commutative-Semiring R)
      ( S)

  is-in-ideal-family-of-subsets-Commutative-Semiring :
    type-Commutative-Semiring R → UU (l1 ⊔ l2 ⊔ l3)
  is-in-ideal-family-of-subsets-Commutative-Semiring =
    is-in-ideal-family-of-subsets-Semiring
      ( semiring-Commutative-Semiring R)
      ( S)

  contains-subset-ideal-family-of-subsets-Commutative-Semiring :
    {α : U} → (S α) ⊆ subset-ideal-family-of-subsets-Commutative-Semiring
  contains-subset-ideal-family-of-subsets-Commutative-Semiring =
    contains-subset-ideal-family-of-subsets-Semiring
      ( semiring-Commutative-Semiring R)
      ( S)

  is-ideal-generated-by-family-of-subsets-ideal-family-of-subsets-Commutative-Semiring :
    is-ideal-generated-by-family-of-subsets-Commutative-Semiring R S
      ( ideal-family-of-subsets-Commutative-Semiring)
      ( λ α → contains-subset-ideal-family-of-subsets-Commutative-Semiring)
  is-ideal-generated-by-family-of-subsets-ideal-family-of-subsets-Commutative-Semiring
    =
    is-ideal-generated-by-family-of-subsets-ideal-family-of-subsets-Semiring
      ( semiring-Commutative-Semiring R)
      ( S)
```

## Properties

### The ideal generated by the underlying subset of an ideal `I` is `I` itself

```agda
module _
  {l1 l2 : Level} (R : Commutative-Semiring l1)
  (I : ideal-Commutative-Semiring l2 R)
  where

  idempotent-ideal-subset-Commutative-Semiring :
    has-same-elements-ideal-Commutative-Semiring R
      ( ideal-subset-Commutative-Semiring R
        ( subset-ideal-Commutative-Semiring R I))
      ( I)
  idempotent-ideal-subset-Commutative-Semiring =
    idempotent-ideal-subset-Semiring
      ( semiring-Commutative-Semiring R)
      ( I)
```

### The operation `S ↦ (S)` preserves least upper bounds

In
[`commutative-algebra.joins-ideals-commutative-semirings`](commutative-algebra.joins-ideals-commutative-semirings.md)
we will convert this fact to the fact that `S ↦ (S)` preserves joins.

```agda
module _
  {l1 l2 l3 : Level} (R : Commutative-Semiring l1)
  {U : UU l2} (S : U → subset-Commutative-Semiring l3 R)
  where

  preserves-least-upper-bounds-ideal-subset-Commutative-Semiring :
    {l4 : Level} (T : subset-Commutative-Semiring l4 R) →
    is-least-upper-bound-family-of-elements-Large-Poset
      ( powerset-Large-Poset (type-Commutative-Semiring R))
      ( S)
      ( T) →
    is-least-upper-bound-family-of-elements-Large-Poset
      ( ideal-Commutative-Semiring-Large-Poset R)
      ( λ α → ideal-subset-Commutative-Semiring R (S α))
      ( ideal-subset-Commutative-Semiring R T)
  preserves-least-upper-bounds-ideal-subset-Commutative-Semiring =
    preserves-least-upper-bounds-ideal-subset-Semiring
      ( semiring-Commutative-Semiring R)
      ( S)
```
